title: nabi ka waris quda ka mazhar ali ali hai
body:
ali ali hai ali ali hai ali ali hai ali ali hai
nabi ka waris quda ka mazhar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghadeere qum ka haseen manzar
saja kajaawou ka ek mimbar
bulandiou par gaye jo hyder
kaha payambar ne muskura kar
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek ka moula mera ye dilbar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke maani hai sab se aala
ali ka matlab hai sab se ooncha
ali hai mushkil kusha hamara
ali sahara hai ambiya ka
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jis pe nazaa'n quda e bartar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
na hota koi bhi maareka sar
na sath deta jo ye ghazamfar
ho jange qandaq ke jange qaibar
yaha bhi hyder waha bhi hyder
<<DIVIDER>>
wo farde tanha quda ka lashkar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quda ki aankhe quda ka chehra
quda ka bazu quda ka lehja
quda ki rehmat ghazab quda ka
wo hubahu kibriya ka jalwa
<<DIVIDER>>
sifaate rab ka hai koun mazhar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb bhi wo ghareeb bhi wo
wo baaghbaa'n bhi adeeb bhi wo
wo momino ka naseeb bhi hai
wo door bhi hai qareeb bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen ka rab falak ka dawar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sajaya rab ne haseen gulshan
mehak raha hai nabi ka aangan
hai tez hoorou ke dil ki dhadkan
hai jaisa dulha hai waisi dulhan
<<DIVIDER>>
jo jiski hamsar nabi ki duqtar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne poocha ke kya hai quraa'n
wo koun hai jo hai jaane imaa'n
wo koun hai jo hai shere yazdaa'n
wo koun hai jo hai shahe mardaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha jawaaban ye maine has kar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kiski sab se siwa fazeelat
wo kispe naaza'n hai qud mashiyat
wo kiski parde me hai haqiqat
badhi hai kaabe ki kis se azmat
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye kaabe ne muskura kar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quda ke dee'n ko baqa nahi hai
jo mazhare kibriya nahi hai
ali ki qudrat me kya nahi hai
magar wo phir bhi quda nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
falak ka maalik zamee'n ka mehwar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke dar ki mile gadaayi
to thokrou me hai baadeshahi
ali ko dunya samajh na paayi
ali ke qabze me hai qudaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen se hadde aasma'n par
ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali to banda nawaz bhi hai
ali bhi aine namaz bhi hai
ghareeb ka chaara saaz bhi hai
ali mashiyat ka raaz bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaseeme jannat kafeele mehshar
ali ali hai ali ali hai
